One physician with a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident, no labs on either; spec newspec-c/flt-oat03-s06-fail-every-try.spec.ts. ai/assist:askChart, ai/assist:generateHandoff and ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes fail at the socket on every attempt. Judged 17/17. (a) Ask AI with the typed question 'List the OAT-03 lab results from this morning.', both contexts: 'The chart assistant couldn’t be reached, so there is no answer. Nothing shown here is a stand-in. Check your connection and tap Ask AI again.', the question kept, the chart's name on screen, no lab value and no answer block, not left on 'Searching…'. (c) Nursing Home Pre-Round Save Note: the typed text kept, 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn’t be updated. Review the text and tap Save Note to retry.', and the Encounter tab keeps Generate disabled ('did not finish processing'); snf:get preRoundNotes equals the typed text; no ok aiCallLog row for the three functions in the run window (every call was refused in the browser). (b) Handoff = TODO (TFA-92586 ready for pr, PR #104 not on main), recorded only: with generateHandoff failing, /rounding/handoff and /snf/handoff each show 'The AI handoff for <name> couldn’t be generated. A chart-based summary is shown instead.' with a chart-based summary; Send was never tapped and no handoff was sent (Q17 / Q13 stay open).

Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT Empty & Failure States 'Ask AI failed'; TFA-94745 AC 4 (handoff) and state 3 · “Explicit error; no invented answer”.

Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S06 AI calls with no failure spec — Ask AI, handoff and the Nursing Home pre-round summary — fail on every attempt: explicit error, nothing invented, input kept, nothing sent (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 When the network drops or an AI provider times out mid-dictation or mid-note-generation, the app retries automatically rather than hanging indefinitely; … (UAT OAT-03 step 1; UAT OAT-03 step 2; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • T2 Each error tells the physician what to do next (retry, check connection, enable permission, sign in) in plain language in the app's existing style (TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 1)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident, neither with labs on file; a fault hook in the agent's browser rejects every ai/assist:askChart, ai/assist:generateHandoff and (Nursing Home) ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes request at the Convex socket (the action-observer route Tim's specs use, s …

When (a) Open Ask About This Patient, type 'List the OAT-03 lab results from this morning.' and tap Ask AI, in each context. (b) Open the handoff sheet (/rounding/handoff, /snf/handoff) with the patient selected; if the sheet lets you edit the text, add ' QA OAT-03 handoff edit.'; do not send. …

Then (a) An explicit error that says there is no answer and what to do next; no lab value presented as an answer; the typed question is still in the box. (b) An explicit message naming the patient that the AI handoff couldn't be generated, with a way to retry; nothing the chart does not hold; the selected patients and any edited text kept; nothing sent. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94745 AC 2 / AC 3 / AC 4 / AC 5, states 3 and 6, 3.3. Ask AI checkpoints mustContain the typed question and the patient, mustNotContain lab words, and need one of the error phrases (mustContainAny). Handoff checkpoints mustContain the patient and 'couldn’t be generated'; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
